teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lesson methodology is quite simple... I do what works for you as an individual. 

Everyone is different. Methods often work differently from person to person. Spending a sufficient amount of time on any task is important to make sure its understood well.

My sessions tend to be quite interactive with articles, video clips and other useful media. Some people prefer a more (strict) style of teacher. If that is what you like, I may not be the person you are looking for.  My style is intentionally relaxed. However, please check for yourself!

teacher_info.introduction: Hi there, my name is Libby and I can't wait to join you on your language learning adventures! Over the years, I've studied French, Ancient Greek, Latin, Old French, German, and Toki Pona in many different situations. I've taken classes at the high school and college level, in both the United States and abroad; I've received private tutoring; and I was selected by the Modern Languages Department of the College of William & Mary to serve as a French tutorffffffffffffff. And now that I've graduated college, I'm studying new languages on my own. So, no matter what your background in language is, I understand where you're coming from and I'm happy to adapt to your individual goals and learning style. If you are interested in learning French, I am experienced in teaching grammatical concepts to students of all levels, and my background in Latin and Old French (the French of the middle ages) means I have a unique perspective on etymology and historical French, if that's something that interests you. I know that learning a new language takes more than the few hours per week that we'll have together, so I want to help you build a comprehensive strategy, using whatever combination of traditional study tools, online resources, and immersion opportunities suits you. If you are interested in learning Ancient Greek, I'm ready with lessons on the alphabet, vocabulary, and multiple approaches to grammar. My broad familiarity with Indo-European languages has exposed me to many ways of explaining these sometimes confusing grammatical concepts. Once you've learned the basics, or if you're already comfortable with them, we can move on to translating genuine ancient texts together. The dialect that I learned is Attic (the language of Plato), but if you understand that dialect, it's very easy to move to Ionic (the language of Homer) and Koine (the language of the New Testament). Please let me know if you would prefer to talk through skype or google hangouts.

pro_course_detail.title: Everyday English for Daily Life
pro_course_detail.description:
1. The first part of class we will warm up by looking at a picture and pretend to be in a setting from everyday life and discussing the 5 Ws (Who, What, When, Where, Why) of what we see in the picture. You will make phrases and I will give you feedback to help correct pronunciation and grammar. This part of the lesson is designed to give you a chance to learn and practice new vocabulary and phrases when you are outside and observing what is going on around you. You will start to think in English. 

2. The next part of the lesson we will use materials that include a combination of Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing activities. These will include PDFs, Videos, Quizzes and Discussion topics for you to use in your interactions with English speakers. The materials will be adjusted to your level and learning objectives.

3. The last part of the lesson will include a cultural component. This could be music and song lyrics, news videos or information about places to visit in an English speaking country.  This is a fun part of the lesson but also very important because language connects us as people, and making connections in business, work or socially is the goal of interacting with anyone.

With all lessons, you can choose if you want to focus more on a specific part or topic and I will design the lessons so you can make progress on your English journey and use what you learn in class.

pro_course_detail.title: General German for Beginners to Elementary (A1-A2)
pro_course_detail.description:
Would you like to build up a strong foundation in German? Do you already know some basic expressions or are you starting to learn the language from scratch? Then this course is for you!

We will use an A1 or A2 level book series to learn vocabulary, practise speaking on a variety of everyday topics, and ease into grammar. Whether you aim to spend some time in a German-speaking country, learn something new, or one day speak German to family, friends, and loved ones, we will work to develop your ability to express yourself and understand spoken and written German for use in everyday life. 

Students will be assigned light homework exercises to review vocabulary and structures covered in class before the next lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Lesestunde: German Reading and Writing (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
In order to improve your reading and writing skills we will practise different reading techniques and strategies and look at writing as a process. During our German lessons we will read an interesting text - at times aloud, at times individually - before completing exercises that will help to strengthen your understanding of the text and expand your vocabulary. You will learn how to avoid writing mistakes and how to successfully structure and edit your own writing so that is easily readable. 
 
Our aim in this course is not to seek perfection or mistake-free German, but rather to strive towards an understandable use of the language in speech and writing and deepen your joy of reading.
 
Um Ihre Lese- und Schreibfertigkeiten zu verbessern werden wir zusammen unterschiedliche Lesetechniken und -strategien üben und das Schreiben als Prozess betrachten. Während der Deutschstunde lesen wir mal vor, mal als Einzelarbeit, und erledigen Aufgaben, die Ihr Verständnis des Textes verfestigen und ihren Wortschatz erweitern sollen. Sie werden lernen wie man Schreibfehler vermeiden kann und einen gut lesbaren Text erfolgreich aufbaut und bearbeitet. 
 
Wir streben nicht nach Perfektion oder fehlerfreiem Deutsch, sondern nach einer verständlichen Sprache in Wort und Schrift und mehr Freude am Lesen.

pro_course_detail.title: Book Club: Reading and Writing in English (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this course you will improve your use of English by reading, discussing, and writing about thought-provoking essays, interviews, articles, and stories of various lengths and types. We will practise reading aloud and individually during our English lessons, although at times you may be asked to read a chapter or medium-length short story at home to prepare for our discussion in the next lesson. We will look at different strategies for using a text to learn new vocabulary, complete comprehension exercises in order to strengthen your understanding of key ideas in the text, and learn to structure and edit your own stories, essays and written responses.
 
Our aim in this course is not to seek perfection or mistake-free English, but rather to strive towards an effective use of the language in speech and writing and deepen your joy of reading.

Homework includes reading passages, answering questions, and short, guided writing responses.

Reading materials include articles, short stories, novels, and poetry.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Travel
pro_course_detail.description:
Adults Only, 16+

Knowing some English phrases can make your trip safer and more fun, even if you’re not traveling to a place where English is the official language!

Going on vacation or a business trip? It’s a great idea to improve your English speaking skills before you go! Knowing some essential English travel phrases will make your trip safer, smoother and more enjoyable.

Here are some topics or situations we might discuss in our lessons:

At the airport: checking in, security, immigration
Transportation: the airplane, trains, buses and taxis
Directions
Hotels: checking in, disputes, asking for recommendations
Food and restaurants: ordering, paying
Shopping
Sightseeing
Talking to locals and new friends
